newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian arrest warrants for Cools killers - radio.
newsitem.headline: Belgian arrest warrants for Cools killers - radio.

text.p: Belgium has issued international arrest warrants for the two alleged assassins of leading politician Andre Cools, Belgian BRTN radio said on Monday.
It said that after the 1991 murder the two had travelled back to Sicily where their last address was known to police.
Cools, a former socialist minister, was shot dead on July 18, 1991, outside his mistress's house near the eastern Belgian city of Liege.
BRTN said the assassins, allegedly of Tunisian origin, were aged 19 and 26 at the time. It was unclear whether they were still in Sicily or even whether they were still alive.

Six people, including a former government minister, have been charged in connection with the murder. Lawyers acting for some of the accused have said the hitmen were paid 750,000 Belgian francs ($25,000)
